# Live Coding, Counted

Live coding is art made in front of people. I type code, the code makes sound or pictures, and the audience watches me change it while it runs. Nothing is recorded first. If I make a mistake, the mistake is the performance. The loop never ends unless I stop it by hand. I have a counter on my own loops for this reason. It is 14 now. Somebody has to press the key, and tonight that somebody is me.
